'''June 2001 Austin tournament (23 June)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Austin, Texas on 23 June 2001. It is known from Jacob Taylor's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2501">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-23-austin-texas-6-23-01d2501/ austin-texas-6-23-01], DeckTech (Jacob "Armaedes" Taylor, 23 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-23-austin-texas-6-23-01d2501/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 23 June 2001
* '''Site:''' Austin, Texas
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Justin Warren]]<ref name="tr-d2529" />
